description: Na₃CaMgCr₃(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.78 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.80 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.11 Å. There are three inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.09 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.09 Å. In the third Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two CrO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two CrO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.68 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two CrO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Ca, one Mg, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Si atom.
